question: Does retaining the circular/radial member tidal stress, rather than only member lumpiness, produce one transferable cluster-lensing correction while leaving isolated galaxies unchanged?

weak_field_equation.matter_split: Phi=Phi_N+phi_Sigma with fixed RAR for matter

environment_tensor.input: observed member positions and relative photometric light weights
environment_tensor.difference_from_prior_test: The prior member-tidal test removed the polar spin-2 circular mean. This test retains that radial stress and solves it analytically while solving only the decaying angular contrast by FFT.
environment_tensor.isolated_galaxy_rule: Q_full_members is an external-member field and is zero for an isolated SPARC galaxy and the Solar System, so the locked fixed-RAR matter score is unchanged.

tensor_coupling.selection_metric: minimum complete-root equal-system exact training radial RMS on MACS0329 and MACS0429; ties favor smaller absolute t
tensor_coupling.ellipticity_preserving_domain: |t|<1 for a full tensor whose eigenvalue magnitude is bounded by one

cluster_split.within_family_rule: hold out the lexicographically last image in every family with at least three images
cluster_split.disclosure: The systems are spent at project level. The formula distinction, grid, selection rule, and gates were frozen before this full-tensor score.

numerics.fft_boundary_rule: Solve the circular tensor analytically and require only the non-circular solver tensor to be small at the FFT boundary.
numerics.interpolation: bilinear with zero angular-contrast correction outside the grid

controls.zero_tensor: t=0 must reproduce the locked scalar-slip lens
controls.randomization_rule: Preserve member radius and light weight, randomize polar angle, and score held-out images with selected geometry and sources fixed.

claim_boundary: This is a first-order projected weak-field closure, not a complete covariant action.
The full member tensor retains radial information already correlated with the spherical baryonic profile, so success would still require a gas-inclusive forward-map confirmation.
No accepted projected gas map is included.
Only held-out cross-cluster improvement with complete exact roots can qualify.
